title: Fuel Prices Bite, JetBlue Digs In, and the A380 Keeps Getting Quietly Retired
summary: Jet fuel is spiking again and WestJet just became the latest airline to feel it, slashing fifteen international routes overnight. Plus, JetBlue and Frontier both posted ugly headline losses but tell very different stories underneath, the A380 keeps losing real estate at two more airlines, and Heathrow just blew up a twelve-year partnership between Delta and Virgin Atlantic.
